steps.caption: The status bar says 'Automation active': checks, research, scoring and updates run in the background.
It is shown on every Automation tab, so you always know the state.
Press Pause automation. You are asked to confirm — nothing is lost, it continues when you resume.
The badge now reads 'Automation paused', with the time it was paused.
While paused, background checks, research, scoring and scheduled runs wait. Your own actions, captures and meeting reminders still run.
System alerts also show that automation is paused, so nobody wonders why scores stopped updating.
Switch tabs — the paused bar stays at the top.
Jobs that would have run stay in the list as Waiting — they are not dropped.
Back to 'Automation active'. Held jobs are released and continue where they stopped.
To stop just one workflow instead, open it from All workflows and use Pause workflow.
